buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 3. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Supply of 20 Nos. of Surface Velocity Program (SVP) Drifters with Holey-Sock Dro gue, Data Logger, Satellite Transmission, Temperature, Conductivity and Atmosp heric Pressure Sensors, Drogue On/Off Sensor, Battery Pack and GPS Module, alo ng with a One-Year Standard Warranty at INCOIS, Hyderabad. Delivery Schedule: Within 240days from the date of acceptance to the Contract/Purchase Order. No part delivery will be entertained. 1. Payment terms: A. Material Component For domestic tender: 90% of the total contract value will be released within 30 days upon successful delivery, a

nd acceptance of material at INCOIS, Hyderabad along with original Ink signed commercial invoice, applicable Test Certificate, Pre-shipment inspection/Q.C. passed certificate, Calibra tion Certificates and warranty undertaking. The balance 10% shall be released upon successful completion of warranty period, or again st submission of 110% of equivalent Advance Bank Guarantee (ABG) valid for a period of 1 4 months from the date of acceptance. For International Vendor: 90% of the contract value shall be released through Usance Letter of Credit against submis sion of Proforma Invoice, Order Acceptance, LC guidelines and other supporting documents . The balance 10% shall be released through wire transfer upon successful completion of wa rranty period, or against submission of 110% of equivalent Advance Bank Guarantee (ABG) for a period of 14 months from the date of acceptance. All bank charges outside India shall be borne by the supplier, while bank charges within In dia shall be borne by the purchaser.Net payment will be released after statutory deductio ns. 3. Warranty Clause: The vendor should provide a standard warranty as follows: The drifter should have a one-year standard warranty against manufacturing defects in the material. f. All the accessories, like cables, power supplies, cradles, Cradles, Chargers, etc., should be warranted for one year. The warranty does not cover any product damage due to mishandling or faulty power supply sources. Performance acceptance at INCOIS: After receiving the drifter at INCOIS. All the drifters will undergo a land-based satellite communication test within 21 days of delivery of item at INCOIS Successful drifters will be accepted by INCOIS and warranty period will be started fr om the date of acceptance of drifter. If a drifter fails to meet the specified operational perfo rmance (supplier should provide the nominal values of sensors during the land-based satell ite communication test) or data availability due to manufacturing defects or design deficien cies, the supplier shall replace the complete drifter or defective subsystem at no additional cost within 90 days of notification. Performance Acceptance after deployment: After deployment, each drifter functions i n accordance with the technical specifications and continuously acquires and transmits scie ntific data through the specified satellite communication system. A drifter shall be consider ed to have successfully met the performance requirements only if it provides continuous sci entific-quality data (Scientific-quality data are defined as data values that fall within the cli matological mean ±3 standard deviations ) for at least 90 consecutive days within the warr anty period (whichever is earlier), with not less than 90% of the expected observations, aft er deployment, without any major hardware or communication failure attributable to the O EM. This warranty clause will cease to exist after one year of acceptance of the drifter at IN COIS, regardless of whether the floats are deployed. If a drifter is deployed during the final

90 days of the standard one-year warranty period, the supplier shall ensure its satisfactory performance for the remaining duration of the warranty period. If the deployment period cr osses the warranty period, this clause will not be valid. The supplier will not be held responsible under the following circumstances: a) In early failure cases, the supplier can prove he was not responsible for the irregular ity, or, if he provides credible circumstances showing he is not at fault (including se nsor fouling, satellite-service interruptions, and failures outside the manuf acturer's control), the case will be excluded from these statistics. b) The affected drifter has grounded/beached, and no fault can be assigned to the sup plier. c) The drifter failure/malfunctioning due to natural drift to shallow waters. d) The function of the drifter was affected through no fault of the supplier and through the means of third parties, such as entanglement of the floats by fishing vandalism, t rawls, and wrong deployments, etc. If the above-mentioned clauses are not met, the supplier will have to compensate with a ne w drifter at the customer’s request within 90 days at no cost to INCOIS. Undertaking mu st be provided for the same with the acceptance/acknowledgment of the Purchase Order. 3. Pre-bid Conference: INCOIS has made every effort to bring out the requirements to facilitate the Firms to make their proposals. However, keeping in view that Firms may have clarifications on certain points in the Document before submitting the Proposal, a Pre-bid meeting will be held at INCOIS, Hyderabad on December 01, 2026 at 11:00 hrs . During the pre-bid meeting, a brief presentation will be done by INCOIS on the bid re quirements. The firms should submit authorisation for Attending Pre bid Conference as per Annexure VII. The firms also are required to make a detailed presentation of their t echnical proposals (Company Profile, Proposed Products, Implementation Plan, etc.) if r equired. It is desired that the firm also demonstrate the features of the products that t hey have quoted. All the clarifications will be consolidated and shared to the vendors a fter the pre-bid meet and addendum/corrigendum will be added in the tender column of INCOIS website (if required only). . 5.
